# WDI — Women's Decision Intelligence MCP

> Open-source MCP (stdio) server with deterministic tools for structuring high-stakes career and life decisions: cash runway, evidence grading, six-dimension option comparison. Not legal, financial or medical advice.

## Tools
- [six_dimension_checklist](https://github.com/alicexixi85/wdi-decision-mcp#tools): the six questions per option
- [calculate_runway](https://github.com/alicexixi85/wdi-decision-mcp#tools): months of runway and safety floor
- [grade_evidence](https://github.com/alicexixi85/wdi-decision-mcp#tools): KNOWN / ASSUMED / UNKNOWN / SYNTHETIC
- [compare_options](https://github.com/alicexixi85/wdi-decision-mcp#tools): weighted ranking with redlines
